declaration.doc: Set one of your own variables. The value appears in your AGENT STATE with its write time. Any short lowercase name is allowed; some names have declared meaning.

parameters.name: name
parameters.constraints: Lowercase letters, digits and underscore; starts with a letter; at most 32 bytes

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Natural-language value, or the typed value the variable declares

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Summary of the value being replaced, when that variable drives a process (such as task) and already holds a value

declaration.doc: Clear one of your own variables. Clearing a variable that is not set changes nothing.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Truthful summary of what happened while the value was set; required when clearing task

declaration.doc: Read a state value now and continue with it. Use a short name for your own variable, or a full path for another source such as ui.windows or platform.system.audio.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Own variable name, or dotted state path

declaration.doc: Atomically load Skills; returns committed state for the following request.

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: JSON array of Skill IDs; atomic update

declaration.doc: Atomically unload non-base Skills; returns committed state for the following request.

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: JSON array of Skill IDs; atomic update

declaration.doc: Relay the user's request, reply or correction to a peer Agent. The receiver decides how to handle it.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: User request, reply, correction or stop request
